subject: orbital-whiskered mole
art_direction: 深梅色绒面鼹鼠的环形胡须绕脸悬浮，小爪捧一颗亮绿色鼻尖般的圆珠。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Design a small mole creature covered in dense plum-colored velvet, with a broad nose and almost hidden ears. Two thin elliptical whisker loops float around the face like balanced wire arcs, clearly separate from the body. Its tiny paws cradle one lime-green wooden bead below the chin. Pose it frontally with shy concentration, keeping the face unobstructed. Use a muted blue-charcoal studio field and soft grazing light that reveals the nap of the velvet. Avoid realistic claws, teeth, wet surfaces, and busy cosmic decoration. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for distinct original concept, appealing silhouette and expression, requested medium, coherent shape/anatomy, clean visual hierarchy, no text or watermark
